recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Reintroducing bindings on removed or commented CarePlan activity-detail elements would be out of current build scope; future changes should first revisit the FHIR-39101 removal decision.
issue_request: FHIR-6212 is Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core CarePlan and requested at least example bindings for CarePlan.participant.role, CarePlan.activity.detail.code, CarePlan.activity.detail.reason, and CarePlan.activity.detail.statusReason.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites SVN #6813. Imported git commit 45a51719e6c526a6bf7df614e1b9f7d5f8c3b4bf added CarePlan value sets and changed CarePlanParticipantRole from unbound to an example value-set binding.
additional_context: FHIR-9765 replaced CarePlan.participant with CarePlan.careTeam referencing CareTeam. FHIR-26064 renamed activity.detail to plannedActivityDetail, and FHIR-39101 removed plannedActivityDetail from the active model. FHIR-22729 later added the CarePlan activity statusReason example binding and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active current source has CarePlan.careTeam, CarePlan.activity.performedActivity with an example binding, CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityReference, and CareTeam.participant.role with the participant-role example binding; it no longer has active CarePlan.activity.detail or plannedActivityDetail children to bind.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-6212 explicitly cites this participant-role value-set issue, and both were applied through SVN 6813.
Replaced CarePlan.participant with CarePlan.careTeam, moving the role binding surface to CareTeam.participant.role.

Removed CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityDetail from the active CarePlan model.
Later statusReason binding issue; already audited on the combined branch.
